lane: Two-view geophysics/subsurface A × surface B co-training; disagreement only, with the A-confident/B-abstaining stratum as the discovery signal.
hypothesis: H74S-A: a restricted View A combining geodetic strain (bands 4/7/8) with the competition's seismic distance/intensity surfaces (bands 10/16) can identify a concealed-fault population where the fixed surface/radiometric View B abstains.
view_B: exact shared H61 view_B_with_external feature list; unchanged

data_provenance.feature_cache_state_before_run: work/r2/features absent in this fresh checkout; rebuild once with the shared builder and disclose
data_provenance.note: Owner-mirror hash/byte integrity is not proof of organizer-byte authenticity. Do not use prior prediction rasters as model features.

experiments: E1: five individual View-A leakage canaries; fit both views using shared spatial folds
E2: spatial-block negative-error independence; at most one buffered whole-segment exchange; matched-budget hide-and-recover versus single_B/random
E3 (conditional): pre-placement surface lane gate; one fixed metric-aware placement; final dots lane/uniqueness/not-union/format checks; write TIFF only if every gate passes

stop_rules: Any per-feature direction-insensitive canary AUC > 0.90: stop and investigate leakage; do not treat the feature as a fault detector.
Undefined or absolute blockwise Pearson/Spearman error correlation >= 0.60: abandon co-training and do not exchange pseudo-labels.
Any arm underfills the fixed 1264-dot-per-fold holdout target: matched comparison invalid; no fallback budget or retuning.
Surface max rank correlation > 0.90 versus any aligned registry raster: log DUPLICATE/STOP before placement.
More than 70% of final dots within 3 px of any single registry raster: log DUPLICATE/STOP; no TIFF and no second placement.
Decoded-pattern uniqueness, >=20% support novelty, or not-union gate fails: no TIFF.
No competition upload or slot selection occurs in this runner, regardless of local gates.
promotion_rule: Selector-eligible only if the shared single_B control at 9400 dots/fold reproduces its reference within 0.001, all arms fill the exact same 1264-dot/fold candidate budget, the paired candidate-minus-single_B HOLDOUT-DTI 95% CI lower bound is >0, candidate exceeds random, leakage and independence gates pass, both lane phases and uniqueness/not-union/format gates pass. Promotion to a real weekly slot is a separate selector and is not performed here.
verdict_rule: NEGATIVE unless every preregistered scientific and technical gate passes; negative results are deliverables.
named_non_fault_mimic: geothermal or volcanic swarm/aftershock sequence, or a geodetic survey/interpolation seam not caused by a fault
registry_scope: 2026-10-08 frozen 526-blob public owner census, current local submission/download TIFFs, and 2026-10-09 refresh of prediction/download/archive/registry rasters from the user-listed H53-H57 owner repositories; excludes private or unlinked artifacts and is not organizer-authenticated.
